last_verified.normal_state: Integrated codex/ws-model-runtime commit 21dbe1e4a3277fa336e73616018994e80847caa7 as a user-space no_std model metadata/registry/Store/provider-contract foundation. Current integration-tree checks pass: 25 unit tests, 2 manifest/schema contract tests, formatting, Clippy with warnings denied, and a Nagi x86_64 user-target library compile. The CRLF-sensitive malformed-manifest test failure from Windows CI was reproduced locally, fixed by removing the field without depending on line endings, and the regression test now passes. Model fixtures are illustrative and contain no distributable weights or source/hash claims; the runtime uses only a test-support fake backend in tests. No model download, host AI service, real inference backend, or runtime app/kernel hook is integrated. Source docs keep M20 NOT STARTED; prior milestones M17-M19 remain incomplete.

Host tests, formatting, Clippy, schema contract tests, and Nagi user-target library compilation pass.
No production inference backend, model weights, host downloader/service, or kernel/runtime hook is included.
